name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on the Lapon Canyon gold project within the Walker Lane gold trend of Nevada. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and a $5M exploration stream earn-in agreement for a 50% interest in the project, which has returned high-grade intercepts including 3.79 g/t gold over 85 metres. The company is advancing toward a maiden NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate.
